risk_description: Data consistency failure in 'Last Write Wins' offline synchronization strategy due to clock drift or race conditions.
root_cause: Reliance on client-side timestamps for conflict resolution in a distributed mobile environment where device clocks are unreliable.
mitigation_strategy: Implement server-side vector clocks or version numbers for authoritative sequencing; Enforce strict UTC formatting; Implement 'dirty' flag persistence in Isar.
contingency_plan: Implement a user-facing 'Conflict Detected' UI dialog allowing manual selection of truth source if auto-resolution fails.
monitoring_trigger: High rate of 409 Conflict responses on POST /api/v1/sync endpoint.

risk_description: Google Books API throttling or rate limiting causing core search functionality denial of service.
root_cause: External dependency on public API limits without a dedicated enterprise agreement; High traffic bursts from batched operations.
mitigation_strategy: Implement aggressive caching layer (Redis) for book metadata; Implement Token Bucket rate limiting on the proxy service; strictly enforce Polly Circuit Breaker policies.
contingency_plan: Fallback to a secondary book data provider (e.g., Open Library) or serve cached 'popular' results only.
monitoring_trigger: Google Books API proxy error rate > 5% or 429 status codes detected.

risk_description: Revenue leakage due to webhook failures or spoofing in Subscription/IAP lifecycle management.
root_cause: Complexity of validating JWS signatures (Apple) and RTDN tokens (Google) combined with asynchronous webhook delivery guarantees.
mitigation_strategy: Enforce strict signature validation middleware; Implement SQS Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) for failed webhook processing; Design idempotent handlers.
contingency_plan: Enable client-side receipt validation backup mechanism (less secure but preserves UX) temporarily while fixing webhook pipeline.
monitoring_trigger: Mismatch count between 'Purchase Success' client events and 'Webhook Received' server events.

risk_description: Inability to adequately test native integrations (IAP, Social Auth, Background Sync) on simulators leads to production defects.
root_cause: Flutter simulators do not accurately replicate StoreKit/Billing Library behaviors, background task restrictions, or authentic OAuth handshakes.
mitigation_strategy: Mandate physical device testing for all native feature PRs; Configure AWS Device Farm or Firebase Test Lab for CI pipeline integration.
contingency_plan: Extend beta testing phase via TestFlight/Google Play Internal Track to capture device-specific issues before public launch.
monitoring_trigger: Spike in crash reports (Sentry) specific to `MissingPluginException` or Platform Channels.

risk_description: AI Recommendation RAG pipeline exceeds 5-second latency threshold, degrading Premium user experience.
root_cause: Sequential latency accumulation: OpenSearch k-NN query + OpenAI Network Latency + Token Generation Time.
mitigation_strategy: Implement semantic caching to serve repeated similar queries instantly; Optimize prompt token count; Use 'Streaming' API response to improve perceived performance.
contingency_plan: Downgrade to a faster, less capable model (e.g., GPT-3.5-turbo) or serve pre-computed non-personalized recommendations.

risk_description: Isar local database schema migration failures causing app crashes or data loss on user devices updates.
root_cause: Mobile NoSQL databases can be fragile during schema changes if migration logic is not strictly versioned and tested on existing datasets.
mitigation_strategy: Write comprehensive migration tests covering data transformation; Avoid breaking changes to existing fields; Use additive schema changes only.
contingency_plan: Implement a 'nuke and resync' fallback that clears local DB and re-downloads from server (high bandwidth cost but saves app utility).
monitoring_trigger: Crash rate spike on new version release associated with database initialization.
